# Prior art — source list

*The PDFs and text extractions themselves are deliberately NOT tracked (see `.gitignore`):
this repository is public and these are published papers whose licences do not generally
grant redistribution. They are present in a local working copy. This list is the tracked
record, so the provenance of every claim in `report.md` and `WRITEUP.md` is complete and
checkable without republishing anyone's paper.*
